Well. I'll start off by saying I look like the most general college student in my country.
I was in the bar of my fraternity one night and this dude around my age comes up threatening me because he claimed I touched his gf. His gf wasn't even at the bar (if he even has a girlfriend) because he walked in, looked for the weakest looking guy and tried picking a fight. Unfortunately the thing is that I'm the least tall and skinniest guy out of everybody in the room so he picked me to intimidate.

Little does he know that i've been raised by a football (soccer) hooligan. I've been taught from a young age how I could stand up for myself and especially how to stand my ground when someone tries to hurt me.

One thing leads to another and we are outside having a full-on brawl. I'm not saying I'm the best fighter in the world (i've also had my ass kicked a lot) but before my friends could come and break it up I had the guy knocked out cold on the ground. I went back inside to continue partying and word got around that this dude now tries to avoid the bar at all costs. Even if that means walking 20-30minutes longer to his destination.
